subject: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Team — aiming to hit public launch early next week (Tue/Wed) pending final gates.

I want us aligned on (1) what we’re saying, (2) where we’re sending traffic, and (3) what “ready” means so Support/SRE aren’t surprised.

Proposed comms targets:
- Docs landing page + walkthroughs (primary)
- GitHub repo release/tag (secondary)
- Console screenshots / observability pack (for “production shape” credibility)

Can each owner reply with:
1) final links for your area
2) any known footguns we must mention (timeouts, 429s, streaming proxies, etc.)
3) ship/no-ship call for Tuesday

Draft checklist (feel free to edit):
- [ ] redwood-quickstarts tagged + release notes
- [ ] docs pages merged + published
- [ ] telemetry contract v1 validated in templates (required attrs/metrics)
- [ ] observability pack import README checked
- [ ] SDK helper versions pinned and referenced (py/ts)
- [ ] security guidance: secrets + PII logging language approved
- [ ] smoke tests green in CI (staging)
- [ ] Support macro/FAQ for top 3 issues (429, streaming disconnects, timeouts)

Attaching:
- Quickstart-Templates-Launch-Brief_v6.pptx
- Quickstart-Templates-Launch-Checklist_v1.3.docx

Links I have so far:
- Repo: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-quickstarts
- Project overview: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/DX/Quickstart+templates+project+overview
- Telemetry contract: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ARCH/Quickstart+telemetry+contract+v1

Thanks,
Alex
—
Alex Martinez
VP, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference


From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 10:01 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Docs side:
- Landing + walkthroughs are in https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-docs/pull/889
- Once merged, URLs will be:
  - /quickstarts (template chooser)
  - /quickstarts/rag
  - /quickstarts/agents
  - /quickstarts/rag-agents
  - /observability/quickstarts (how to import dashboards + what to look at)

Footguns to call out (we added callouts/notes in the PR but can add more if needed):
- Streaming behind proxies: ensure proxy supports SSE + does not buffer; we point to SDK guidance + a “try non-streaming” troubleshooting step.
- 429 behavior: show “respect Retry-After” + exponential backoff; explain that initial free-tier defaults can hit rate limits quickly.
- Timeouts on ingestion: advise bumping ingestion worker timeout + chunk sizes; we include a “large docs” config snippet.

Ship readiness:
- If PR 889 merges by EOD Thu, we’re good for Tue.
- If it slips, I’d rather delay announcement than launch with stale links.

Wei — can you sanity-check code snippets vs repo one more time after final tag? We had drift once already.

-Elliot


From: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 10:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Yep — I’ll do a final pass once we have:
- quickstarts release tag (v1.0.0)
- docs PR merged

I’ll run our snippet extraction check locally + confirm:
- env var names match across Python/TS (esp. REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_BASE_URL, REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
- telemetry section reflects contract v1 naming (no old metric names)
- copy/paste commands work on a clean machine

Also: suggest we add a short “if you’re on a corporate proxy” section to the Agents page (SSE + keep-alive). We can keep it minimal but it prevents a ton of confusion.

Wei


From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 11:07 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Product / Hosted API callouts:
- Please make sure the default examples set request_id and propagate trace context. That’s key for Console “find this request” flows.
- Also: we should mention that the templates are compatible with Hosted now, and map cleanly to Dedicated/Private, but “Private guide” is a follow-up doc (don’t overpromise).

Links:
- API header behavior tweak that templates depend on landed already (request_id echo + traceparent passthrough).
- I’ll send Henry’s final note on the header naming to keep docs consistent.

Ship/no-ship: OK for Tue from my side as long as smoke tests are green and we don’t regress first-call UX.

Nikhil


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 12:22 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Console / rollouts:
- I’m aligned with keeping the announcement scope to “templates + observability pack,” and leaving “rollouts/canaries” as a sidebar.

What we should include (short):
- Templates emit: request_id, tenant, model, route, token usage → shows up in Console cost and latency breakdowns.
- Dashboard import option (one-click JSON import) with “what good looks like” notes.

Link:
- Observability pack PR (dashboards + alert rules + README): https://github.com/redwoodinference/observability-pack/pull/206

Footgun: make sure we explicitly advise people to keep high-cardinality tags (user_id, email) OUT of metrics. Paula’s contract already says this, but we should repeat it.

Ship/no-ship: OK for Tue.

Marissa


From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 9:46 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

SDK status:
- Python: retry/timeout helper + streaming resiliency shipped last week; templates pin to >= 0.14.2.
- TypeScript: 429 handling improvements + trace context helper shipped; templates pin to >= 0.9.6.

Ask for launch copy: please include ONE sentence on 429s:
“On 429, back off and retry with jitter; respect Retry-After; do not spam retries in parallel.”

Also: templates default timeouts are conservative for inference calls; ingestion worker has separate timeout; docs should clarify that (avoids ‘my RAG is broken’ tickets).

Ship/no-ship: OK for Tue.

Monica


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Wei Chen <wei.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Renee Sullivan <renee.sullivan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch comms plan: Quickstart templates (RAG + Agents) — final checklist + links

Locking plan for Tue 2/17 AM PT.

Source of truth links (please use these in any internal/external comms):
- Quickstarts repo + release: https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-quickstarts/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Docs PR (merge target Monday): https://github.com/redwoodinference/redwood-docs/pull/889
- Observability pack (merge target Monday): https://github.com/redwoodinference/observability-pack/pull/206

Final launch gates (must be green by Mon 5pm PT):
1) CI smoke tests against staging green (ENG-2848)
2) Docs PR merged + site deploy succeeded (ENG-2850)
3) Repo tagged v1.0.0 + README points to correct docs URLs
4) Security wording: secrets + PII guidance present in each template README (no logging of prompts/responses by default)
5) Support ready: short FAQ posted internally + Slack handoff to #support for launch week

Comms:
- Internal: I’ll post in #announcements Tue 9:30am with links + “where to file issues” (GitHub + Linear intake).
- External: Renee, please prep the community post + short demo clip (keep it under 90s). No mention of any upcoming managed agent runtime.

Open item:
- Wei: add the proxy/SSE note (minimal) to agents docs page before merge.

Thanks all — this is exactly the kind of “production-shaped” onboarding we’ve needed.

Alex
—
Alex Martinez
VP, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference
